requiredScenarios: persistent Void Chest inventory across death, new run, and process relaunch
save/resume without duplicate or forked stash state
disabled package leaves vanilla Void Chest behavior unmodified
builtGameBehavior.notes: These scenarios are planned but not yet passed against a patched playable Barony build.

rollback.notes: Rollback means disabling the jml.stash package for affected profiles and launching an unpatched Barony executable until a patched build has passed the required scenarios.
steps: Disable jml.stash in the profile package state before launch.
Use the previous unpatched Barony executable or restore the pre-patch source tree before building.
Preserve BaronyModLoader profile state for inspection; do not migrate or delete stash inventory files unless the user explicitly chooses data removal.
Regenerate launch/runtime manifests after the package is disabled so stale capability metadata is not reused.
rollback.risk: Existing experimental stash state may be unreadable by vanilla Barony; preserve it separately rather than silently converting or deleting it.
